note: Which model sits in which seat. The skill reads this at every run. Change a seat only after testing — a newer model is not automatically better at a given job.

parent.job: scopes the question, briefs each team, writes draft and final answer

research.job: one agent per research angle; discovery, not judgment

qa.job: independent fact-checkers; re-verify every load-bearing claim

review.job: does the conclusion follow from the facts?

adversary.job: paid to refute the draft, one lens each

second_opinion.job: Max tier only: one QA seat and one adversary seat from a different model, for different blind spots

codex.job: Max tier only: one QA seat from a different vendor; skipped silently when unavailable
